name: Aeneas (Healed in Lydda)
title: The Paralytic Who Was Healed
summary: Aeneas was a man in Lydda who had been bedridden and paralyzed for eight years. He was miraculously healed by the apostle Peter, and this miracle led many in Lydda and on the plain of Sharon to believe in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Bedridden for Eight Years
keyEvents.description: Aeneas had been paralyzed and bedridden for eight years in the city of Lydda, unable to move.

keyEvents.title: Peter Heals Aeneas
keyEvents.description: The apostle Peter came to Lydda and said to Aeneas: 'Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!' Immediately Aeneas got up.

keyEvents.title: The Healing Leads to Repentance
keyEvents.description: All who lived in Lydda and on the plain of Sharon saw the healed Aeneas, and they turned to the Lord.
